title: Complier Risk Contrasts and Sign Decisions in Case-Control Instrumental Variable Designs
banked_reason: terminal:below-floor at field floor; D0.5 mathematical status REVISE, not established; original-experiment adaptive transfer remains unproved
gap_reasons: the finite-N family P^t_{N,h} is not concretely specified
passes from bounded-local LAN convergence to a supremum over all h through an asserted exponential tail bound without establishing that bound uniformly for the undefined original paths
proof_attempt_summary: D0 developed the endpoint-qualified protected-scale classification, Gaussian two-cone decision frontier, reference-cost threshold, and an adaptive original-experiment attainment claim. D0.5 stopped below the field novelty floor and marked the mathematics REVISE: the tangent LAN expansion, multivariate uniform CLT, and all-h adaptive transfer are not established. A follow-on attempt would need an explicit finite-N path/nuisance class and a uniform tail-transfer theorem before the adaptive headline can be considered proved; no theorem package in this entry is certified sound.
tldr: Outcome-stratified instrumental-variable data can leave population prevalence unidentified even when the sign null is visible. The paper classifies the smooth complier-risk contrasts that remain regular, with the necessary endpoint qualification, and solves the unprotected risk-difference problem in the original multinomial/reference experiment. A unique cubic ray gives the exact all-rules effect-weighted sign-regret constant and one-sided power envelope. Joint acquisition has a sharp source-margin cost threshold, and a pilot-measurable design attains the first-order oracle uniformly through the boundary between positive and zero reference allocation; the minimax second-order adaptive frontier is left as an explicit question.
gap: Published case-control IV work explains how external population information reconstructs causal effects, and generic decision theory explains hardest Gaussian subproblems, but neither determines the attainable directional evidence for the nonlinear complier risk difference when the external instrument margin is estimated.
fill: The paper derives the profiled experiment, cubic supporting ray, all-rules regret constant, maximin power envelope, endpoint-qualified scale classification, reference-cost threshold, and exact fixed-score Neyman benchmark, then isolates adaptive design attainment as the remaining open theorem.
